source.title: High-frequency trading in a limit order book
source.version: Working paper dated October 5, 2006 (NOT the Quantitative Finance 8(3) 2008 published version)
source.transcribed_by: model-assisted transcription from uploaded PDF; every value must be checked by hand against the page

simulation_params.mid_update: binary increment +/- sigma*sqrt(dt) per step (page 10), not Gaussian
simulation_params.fill_rule: ask filled with probability lambda(delta_a)*dt: q -= 1, wealth += s + delta_a; bid filled with probability lambda(delta_b)*dt: q += 1, wealth -= s - delta_b (page 10)
simulation_params.quote_timing: quotes computed at t from current state; state updated at t + dt (page 10)

transcription_notes: The 'Spread' column equals (2/gamma)*ln(1 + gamma/k) only (1.2908, 1.3289, 1.1507), not the full eq. 3.18 spread at t=0 (1.6908, 1.3689, 3.1507). See open question 1.
Paper text states the symmetric strategy 'uses the same bid/ask spread as the inventory strategy' centred on the mid-price (page 11).
'Profit' is not defined explicitly in section 3.3. Presumed terminal wealth plus inventory marked at the terminal mid. See open question 3.
